lines.en: I sweep my tail and glide forward
The waterweed bends beside me
I swim slowly, with power
My fins are like four short legs
I move along the riverbed
I stir up the silt

lines.zh: 我从一段沉木上越过去
lines.en: I pass over a sunken log

lines.zh: 我的身体比看起来更长
lines.en: I am longer than I look
Water passes my gills
I swim under the reed roots
The bend is shallow, so I slow

lines.zh: 我摆一下尾，就前进了半格
lines.en: One tail sweep, half a block forward
I pass over a stretch of gravel bed
The light on the surface cannot reach me

lines.zh: 我的尾巴把泥扫成一道
lines.en: My tail sweeps the silt into a line
I slip sideways with the current
My old trails lie on the riverbed
I go around the pier
I hang in the water, still
Waterweed drifts by my mouth
My teeth are white in the water
I watch the light on the surface
The riverbed is quiet
I open my mouth, then close it
My fins scull slowly
Something walks on the surface
My teeth are hooked.
Silt drifts beneath me
I wait for something to enter the water
The water here is murky
I pause in a gap between stones
The water rocks me gently
You stand on the bank, very visible
The water is the line
Step into the water and things change
My teeth are not decorative
I look up at you from below
Your shadow distorts in the water
Part of this river is mine
Do not put your hand in this river.
I rise a little
You cannot see me from the surface
I rolled over in the water
My scales were cut open
Threads of blood spread through the water.
That landed on my flank
The water dulls the pain
I sweep my tail and withdraw
My fins are less nimble

lines.zh: 我的牙能咬穿肉鳍，别伸手。
lines.en: My teeth pierce fins; keep your hand back.
I can still swim
I will remember this wound
Something fell into the water
Whatever sinks is mine
Your fingers look like worms in the water.
Throw down a bigger piece of meat.
I circle toward it slowly
The splash gave me away

lines.zh: 这点东西换不来我的注意
lines.en: That will not hold my attention
Throw another, I am watching
It floats in the water
When I am sure, I move
You hit my flank
One tail slap and the mud boils up.
In the water it is hard to tell
My scales are slick
You have reached the riverbed
The water is churned up
I turn to face you
That had no weight behind it
My fleshy fin brushes your knee.
You had best get back to the bank
Few of my kind in this river
We find each other by vibration in the water
Two swimming together stirs the water

lines.zh: 我看见一段更长的影子
lines.en: I see a longer shadow
It circled me once
The bend is enough for two

lines.zh: 我们一起守着这段浅滩
lines.en: We share this stretch of shallows
We do not call, we wave our tails
It went upstream
I did not follow
I clamp down and hold
It slipped between my teeth
I sweep it over with a fin
Sinking things are my specialty
I pin it to the riverbed
This one is a bit hard
I hold it, then spit it out
I can see everything in the water
This cannot be eaten
I reach dropped things first
The bank water ripples; I raise my head.
I heard a splash
Something bigger than a fish
I swim that way
The ripples tell me where it is
I follow beneath it
It has entered the water
That shadow under the water is mine.
I know this stretch of riverbed
No hurry, the water will help me
I follow along the riverbed

lines.zh: 它每动一下，水就告诉我
lines.en: Every movement tells me through the water
I am below it, out of sight
I count how fast it sinks
One tail sweep and I catch up

lines.zh: 水面上的影子往那边去了
lines.en: The shadow on the surface went that way
I move downstream of it
The waterweed blocks its view
The water is deep here, and that favors me
It is heading for the bank
I open my jaws and bite
That bite tore the water
My teeth clamp and hold
I shake my head and tear it
My teeth are very sharp
The water is full of blood
These teeth are sharp. The water is mine.
It broke free that time
I ram with my body
On land I have little strength
I come up from the deep silt
One more shadow in the river
I test the current first

lines.zh: 这里的水比我记得的浑
lines.en: The water is murkier than I remember
I move along the riverbed
My dorsal fin cuts the surface
The waterweed parts and I pass
I have always been in this river

lines.zh: 我从英国的老河里来的
lines.en: I come from an old river in Britain
I swim slowly into the shallows
The bottom clouds as I stir it
I come out from under a sunken log

lines.zh: 水面上烧起来了，我往下躲
lines.en: The surface burns and I dive lower

lines.zh: 有东西砸下来，水被压开
lines.en: Something fell and the water was pushed aside
I never drown

lines.zh: 爆炸把河底都掀起来了
lines.en: The blast lifted the riverbed

lines.zh: 飞来的东西扎穿了我的鳞
lines.en: Something flying pierced my scales
That force chased me through the water

lines.zh: 河里没什么可吃，我越来越瘦
lines.en: Nothing to eat here, I grow thin

lines.zh: 雷顺着水传过来，我全身一颤
lines.en: Lightning ran through the water and I convulsed
There is not even water in the void
